# bcapi.ai: BC API Catalog v3

> Free, open source Business Central extension (MIT) that exposes 187 standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central tables as OData v4 API pages: 135 read/write and 52 read-only. Every W1 field, localization-neutral, served at /v3.0/ and /v3.1/. Version 3.1.3.0, by AJ Ansari.

## Key links

- [Website and documentation](https://bcapi.ai/): landing page, install steps, full reference of every entity and field
- [Getting Started](https://bcapi.ai/#docs): install, permissions and first request
- [Reference](https://bcapi.ai/#docs/reference): every entity, source table, page ID, key and field
- [FAQ](https://bcapi.ai/#docs/faq)
- [Changelog](https://bcapi.ai/#docs/changelog)
- [Source code and issues](https://github.com/ajansari/ocpfBCAPIsV3)
- [Download the .app](https://github.com/ajansari/ocpfBCAPIsV3/raw/main/OnlyCopilotFans_OCPF%20APIs%20v3_3.1.3.0.app)

## API groups

- Core Financial (ocpf_coreFinancial): 25 entities, 17 read/write, e.g. ocpfChartOfAccounts, ocpfGeneralLedgerEntries, ocpfGeneralLedgerSetup, ocpfAccountingPeriods
- Master Data (ocpf_masterData): 31 entities, 26 read/write, e.g. ocpfBankAccounts, ocpfBankAccountPostingGroups, ocpfBankAccountLedgerEntries, ocpfPaymentTerms
- Sales (ocpf_sales): 20 entities, 12 read/write, e.g. ocpfSalesQuotes, ocpfSalesQuoteLines, ocpfSalesOrders, ocpfSalesOrderLines
- Purchasing (ocpf_purchasing): 20 entities, 12 read/write, e.g. ocpfPurchaseOrders, ocpfPurchaseOrderLines, ocpfPurchaseInvoices, ocpfPurchaseInvoiceLines
- Projects & Assets (ocpf_projectsAndAssets): 14 entities, 12 read/write, e.g. ocpfProjects, ocpfProjectPostingGroups, ocpfProjectTasks, ocpfProjectPlanningLines
- System & Setup (ocpf_systemAndSetup): 9 entities, 6 read/write, e.g. ocpfDocumentAttachments, ocpfCompanyInformation, ocpfWarehouseEntries, ocpfReminderHeaders
- Manufacturing (ocpf_manufacturing): 34 entities, 29 read/write, e.g. ocpfManufacturingSetup, ocpfWorkShifts, ocpfShopCalendars, ocpfShopCalendarWorkingDays
- Service Management (ocpf_serviceManagement): 30 entities, 20 read/write, e.g. ocpfServiceMgtSetup, ocpfServiceOrderTypes, ocpfServiceCosts, ocpfServiceZones
- Access Control (ocpf_accessControl): 4 entities, 1 read/write, e.g. ocpfPermissionSets, ocpfPermissionSetPermissions, ocpfUsers, ocpfPermissionSetAssignments

## Notes

- URL pattern: https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/v2.0/<tenantId>/<environment>/api/OnlyCopilotFans/<apiGroup>/v3.1/companies(<companyId>)/<entitySetName>
- Requires Business Central 2025 Wave 2 (v27.5) or later (SaaS or on-premises). Request $metadata on any API group to discover fields.
